scope: First-party .rs files known to Git (tracked and untracked nonignored); excludes .codex, .agents, third_party, target. Lexical clone, cloned, clone_from and Arc::clone invocations. Macro bodies included. Includes qualified calls and a Bundle::clone callback reference; not a scan for every implicit copy or to_owned operation.
method: Complete inventory and per-site triage; targeted semantic review and compiler diagnostics. Retained generic entries are not individually certified as necessary. Platform-gated sources may only have source review.

owned-data-or-handle.assessment: Retained after source-pattern and compiler triage; no safe local elimination was established. Check the owning function for snapshot, retained-state, wire/output or task ownership. This is not a proof of necessity.
owned-data-or-handle.evidence: source-pattern triage and supported-target compiler liveness checks

shared-owner.assessment: Reference-counted ownership, not a deep copy of the pointee. Keep the independent owner required by the current API/task/state lifetime.
shared-owner.evidence: explicit Arc::clone or compiler clone_on_ref_ptr type diagnostic

fixture-or-expected-value.assessment: Retained fixture/expected-value/shared-fake ownership after redundant-clone lint triage. This category alone does not prove a clone is necessary on every platform.
fixture-or-expected-value.evidence: source-pattern triage and supported-target compiler liveness checks

destination-update.assessment: Update an existing destination while retaining the source. Allocation reuse depends on the concrete type; replacing this with assignment would still copy ownership.
destination-update.evidence: source-pattern triage and supported-target compiler liveness checks

benchmark-input-or-output.assessment: Retained independent mutable working input or owned result metadata. Copying input samples can be required even when buffer allocation could be reused.
benchmark-input-or-output.evidence: source-pattern triage and supported-target compiler liveness checks
